leadText: Becky (Japanese: ベッキー) is a Japanese voice actress for . She is a popular Japanese presenter and , who first appeared on Oha Suta in 1999, where she would read out the names of various Pokémon characters. She has also performed an opening for Pokémon Sunday titled Hello! Thank You!. The soundtrack from Hello! Thank You and Soaring Pokémon Kids would later appear on CDs released by Becky.
